  - The payment qualifies for the published "Self-Pay Payoff Terms": full payment inside the 45-day window (18 days after the first statement 03-28), balance 8055.00 ≥ 500.00 minimum, eligible channel, no charity adjustment, no payment plan.
  - Under those terms, the payment amount due is the self-pay payoff amount, and the whole difference from the balance standing posts as one prompt-pay discount.
  - The amount is figured under "Self-Pay Payoff Amount" and its Combination clause, from the base percent and the published allowances:

    | Input | Value | Effect |
    |---|---|---|
    | Inpatient base percent | 15 % | base |
    | Gross charges standing | 17900.00 (≥ 7500) | +3 points |
    | Ledger balance | 8055.00 (≥ 2000) | +1 point |
    | Latest statement channel | US mail | +0 |
    | Statement recency | 18 days | +0 |
    | Point-of-service payments | none | +0 |
    | Window days left | 45 − 18 = 27 | 27 × 2.00 = 54.00 dollar credit |
